notes: UniMTS wrist-only reimplementation (joint-mask recipe, 100 epochs, final checkpoint), scored by scripts/eval_retrieval_alignment.py on the HumanML3D TEST split with the benchmark's galleries and seed (3,704 items; the controlled encoders' loader rejects three of them and scores 3,701; the validation split is identical at 1,197). Text-to-IMU is at chance because of hubness: its text embeddings are nearly collinear (mean pairwise cosine 0.996) while per-IMU-item similarity offsets are 15x the within-row spread, so on the validation split 1,197 text queries retrieve only 5 distinct IMU items; removing each IMU item's mean similarity restores text-to-IMU R@1 from 0.17% to 3.84% (IMU-to-text 4.18%). Check: analysis/retrieval_eval/unimts_hubness_check.py.
